dose.frequency: once at migraine onset; may repeat after at least 2 hours if partial response

regimens.dose_text: Single oral dose of 25 mg, 50 mg, or 100 mg at migraine onset. If migraine has not resolved by 2 hours or returns after transient improvement (with some response to first dose), a second dose may be given at least 2 hours later. Maximum daily dose: 200 mg in 24 hours. Safety of treating >4 headaches per 30 days not established.
